recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the existing all-codes implementation path for the two issue-named elements without changing unrelated code-system semantics. A later full publication build should regenerate rendered artifacts and diagrams from these source changes.
issue_request: FHIR-50614 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked how SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.modifier and Subscription.filterBy.modifier should express the search :type modifier when the value is the resource type itself, such as Patient, rather than the literal code type. The accepted resolution was to expand search modifier value-set coverage to include extended resource types.
initial_application: The issue-tagged commit 584ea5fadb47d6ef43add3666481a61e7733c133 added ValueSet/search-modifier-all-codes, composing the search-modifier-code system with ValueSet/extended-resource-types, and changed SearchParameter.modifier to use that broader value set. Follow-up commits 926c1640e358deb6e9f306569fb474261b372770 and ac7f9d06d91a4955834ac69f9bfcee1185e23ce5 registered and case-corrected the original search-modifier-code value-set file, but the Subscription and SubscriptionTopic modifier elements still used the narrower value set.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2025-12-08 confirmed the Persuasive with Modification decision as adding codes to a normative value set, and June 2025 minutes show the issue had been assigned for review because R6/backport handling differed. Current build.fhir.org artifacts before this reconciliation still had Subscription.filterBy.modifier and SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.modifier bound to search-modifier-code while SearchParameter.modifier used search-modifier-all-codes. The edited StructureDefinition files are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and source/search.html is active narrative. Generated SVG diagrams were intentionally not edited.
reconciliation: Changed Subscription.filterBy.modifier and SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.modifier to bind to ValueSet/search-modifier-all-codes, clarified the SearchParameter/Subscription/SubscriptionTopic definitions and binding descriptions to include resource type codes for :type, updated the all-codes value-set title/description, and corrected search.html to link to search-modifier-all-codes with a subject:Patient example.
source_changes: source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml: bound Subscription.filterBy.modifier to ValueSet/search-modifier-all-codes and clarified that resource type codes may be used with :type.

source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml: bound SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.modifier to ValueSet/search-modifier-all-codes and clarified allowed resource type codes.
source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml: aligned the modifier definition and binding description with the broader all-codes value set already used by SearchParameter.modifier.
source/searchparameter/valueset-search-modifier-all-codes.xml: updated title and description to state that the value set includes resource type codes for :type.
source/search.html: updated narrative to link to search-modifier-all-codes and explain subject:Patient resource type syntax.
